div.l: He neuer͗ yit / no velanye ne sayde
In alle his lyue / vn to no maner wyht
He was a verray ꝑperfith / gentil knyht
But for to telle yow / of his array
His hors was good / but he ne was nat gay
Of Fustian / he weryd a gypoun
Al besmotered / with his haberyoun
For he was late / come from his viage
And wente for to don / his pilgrimage
WYth hym ther was / his sonne a yong sqwyer
A louere / and a lusty bacheleer
With lockes crul / as they wer leyd in presse
He twenty yer of age / was as I gesse
Off his stature / he was of evene lengthe
And wondirly delyuer / and grete of strenghe
And he hadde be / somtyme in chyvalrye
In flaıı̄undres Artoys / and in pikardye
And born hym wel / as of so lytyl space
In hope / to stondyn in his lady grace
Embroyded was he / as it were a mede
Al full of froysh flowres / white and reede
Syngyng he was / and floytyng al the day
He was as froysh as the moneth of may
Short was his gowne / with sleves longe ⁊and wyde
Weel cowde he sytte on hors / and fayre ryde
He cowde songes make / and wel endyte
Iuste and daıı̄unce / and wel portreye and wryte
So hote he loved / that be nyhterdale
He sleep no more / than doth the nyhtyngale
Curteys he was / lovely and seruysable
And carf bi forn / his fader at the table
A Yeman̄ he hadde / and ʆservaıı̄untys no mo
At that tyme / for hym lyst· ryde so
And he was clad / in cote and hood grene ·
